info.title: EasyPost
info.description: Authentication: HTTP Basic Auth (API key as username, blank password). EasyPost is a multi-carrier shipping API for rating, label purchase, address verification, package tracking, customs, insurance, and pickup scheduling across supported carriers.
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 81 of 110 upstream operations covering common CRUD for shipping automation: addresses, parcels, customs info/items, shipments (create/buy/rate/label/refund/insure), trackers, insurance, claims, pickups, batches, orders, end shippers, carrier accounts/types, scan forms, webhooks, events, and user/child-account management. Excluded: EasyPost's own billing/Stripe funding flow, referral/reseller administration, reporting, carrier-specific OAuth registration flows, beta/Luma rate-prediction endpoints, and the standalone ReadyDocs product. See the repo README for the full breakdown and the full spec.

tags.name: Basics > Addresses
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/addresses](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/addresses) [Address](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/addresses#address-object) objects represent people, places, and organizations and are used in multiple contexts across the EasyPost API. For example, a [Shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments) requires both a `to_address` and `from_address` to calculate rates and generate postage.

tags.name: Basics > Insurance
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/insurance](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/insurance) An [Insurance](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/insurance#insurance-object) object represents insurance for packages purchased both via the EasyPost API as well as shipments purchased through third parties and later registered with EasyPost. An `Insurance` object is created automatically whenever you [buy a Shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments#buy-a-shipment) through EasyPost and pass insurance options during the call,or in a later call to [insure a Shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/shipping-insurance#insure-a-shipment).

tags.name: Basics > Insurance > Claims
tags.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/insurance/claims](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/insurance/claims)

The `Claims API` allows shippers to automate submitting and managing insurance claims for lost, damaged, or stolen packages. This endpoint streamlines claim submissions and provides an automated experience. Claims can be submitted via the [EasyPost Dashboard](https://app.easypost.com/account/settings?tab=api-keys), a [Claim Submission Form](https://app.easypost.com/claim-form), or the [Claims API](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/insurance/claims#create-a-claim).

tags.name: Basics > Parcels
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/parcels](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/parcels) [Parcel](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/parcels#parcel-object) objects represent the physical container being shipped.

tags.name: Basics > Rates
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/rates](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/rates) After a [Shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments) is successfully created, it will automatically fetch [Rates](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/rates#rate-object). You can limit the [CarrierAccounts](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/carrier-accounts) to use for rating by passing the `carrier_accounts` parameter upon `Shipment` creation.

tags.name: Basics > Shipments
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments) The workhorse of the EasyPost API, a [Shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments#shipment-object) is made up of a "to" and "from" [Address](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/addresses), the [Parcel](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/parcels) being shipped, and any [Forms](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/forms) required for international deliveries. Once created, a `Shipment` object is used to retrieve shipping [Rates](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/rates) and purchase a label. A `Shipment` created with a valid `to_address`, `from_address`, and `parcel` will automatically populate its `rates` attribute.

tags.name: Basics > Shipments > Form
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/forms](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/forms) After a [Shipment is created](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments#create-a-shipment), you can create various associated [Form](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/forms#form-object) objects for that `Shipment`, such as a return packing slip, QR codes, and other international shipping forms. For more information about how to use forms with your shipments, please check our [forms guide](https://docs.easypost.com/guides/form-guide).

tags.name: Basics > Shipments > Luma
tags.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/luma](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/luma)

The Luma API enables shippers to buy labels, leveraging the rate shopping rules configured within the [EasyPost Dashboard](https://app.easypost.com/login). By using predefined rulesets, Luma automates the rate selection process based on criteria such as transit time, cost, carrier preferences, and delivery confidence levels.

tags.name: Basics > Shipments > Options
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/options](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/options)

tags.name: Basics > Shipments > Rate
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/rates](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/rates) After a [Shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments) is successfully created, it will automatically fetch [Rates](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/rates#rate-object). You can limit the [CarrierAccounts](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/carrier-accounts) to use for rating by passing the `carrier_accounts` parameter upon `Shipment` creation.

tags.name: Basics > Shipments > Return
tags.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/returns](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/returns)

If you are shipping merchandise or other frequently-returned products, you may wish to generate return labels to include with your shipment, for you customer's convenience. EasyPost offers a simple way to submit the same parameters as your initial shipment, but with an additional flag set, that will generate you a return label to receive any return shipments at your original from address.

tags.name: Basics > Shipments > Shipping Insurance
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/shipping-insurance](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/shipping-insurance) Shipping insurance can be purchased for any [Shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments) by specifying the value of the shipment's contents. The cost is 1.0% of the declared value, with a minimum charge of $1.00. All claims are processed and paid within 10 days.

tags.name: Basics > Shipments > Shipping Refund
tags.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/shipping-refund](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/shipping-refund)

USPS shipping labels can be refunded if requested within 30 days of generation. The processing time is at least 15 days, after which the funds will return to your EasyPost balance. EasyPost fees will also be refunded. To qualify, a shipment must not have been scanned by the USPS.

tags.name: Basics > Shipments > SmartRate
tags.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/shipping-smartrate](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/shipping-smartrate)

The Shipping SmartRate API provides shippers with highly accurate, shipment-level transit time predictions that can save money, improve on-time delivery, and provide end customers with reliable delivery estimates.

tags.name: Basics > Shipments > TaxIdentifier
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/tax-identifiers](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/tax-identifiers) [TaxIdentifiers](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/tax-identifiers#taxidentifier-object) are identifying numbers or IDs that are used to charge a specific party when dealing with the importing or exporting of good across international borders.

tags.name: Basics > Shipments > EndShipper
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/endshippers](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/endshippers) **Important**: This endpoint only works for users of the EndShipper API. If you feel this is applicable for your use case, please contact [sales](https://www.easypost.com/talk-to-easypost). The EndShipper API is for platforms purchasing postage on behalf of their users, the EndShipper. Platforms must assert the EndShipper details, as the EndShipper is ultimately responsible for what is in the box. Multiple labels purchased for the same EndShipper must use the same [EndShipper](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/endshippers#endshipper-object) object.

tags.name: Basics > Trackers
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/trackers](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/trackers) The [Tracker](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/trackers#tracker-object) object contains tracking information for a package. A `Tracker` is created automatically when a [Shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments#buy-a-shipment) is purchased through EasyPost. For labels not purchased via EasyPost, a `Tracker` can still be created directly through the API.

tags.name: Advanced > Batches
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches) The [Batch](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches#batch-object) object allows you to perform operations on multiple [Shipments](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments) at once. This includes [scheduling a Pickup](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pickups#create-a-pickup), [creating a ScanForm](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/scan-form#create-a-scanform), and consolidating labels. Operations performed on `Batches` are asynchronous and take advantage of our [webhook](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/events) infrastructure. **Note:** `batches_buy` is not in the main documentation and doesn't work with the in-place created batch. If looking to create a batch with more shipments, use the add X shipments to batch collection.

tags.name: Advanced > Carrier Metadata
tags.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/carrier-metadata](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/carrier-metadata)

The Carrier Metadata endpoint returns information about all the carriers available on the EasyPost platform. This information may include service levels, predefined packages, shipment options, supported features, and more that are available per carrier. This metadata can be useful during onboarding and integration or when determining the ideal carrier mix for your setup.

tags.name: Advanced > CustomsInfo
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-infos](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-infos) [CustomsInfo](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-infos#customsinfo-object) objects contain [CustomsItem ](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-items) objects and all necessary information for the generation of customs forms required for international shipping. Please see the [Shipments documentation](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments) for examples of including a `CustomsInfo` object in a `Shipment`.  **Note:** the maximum number of items that can be included in customs info with UPS is 100.

tags.name: Advanced > CustomsItem
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-items](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-items) A [CustomsItem](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-items#customsitems-object) object describes goods for international shipment and should be created then included in a [CustomInfo](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-infos) object.

tags.name: Advanced > EndShipper
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/endshippers](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/endshippers) **Important**: This endpoint only works for users of the EndShipper API. If you feel this is applicable for your use case, please contact [sales](https://www.easypost.com/talk-to-easypost). The EndShipper API is for platforms purchasing postage on behalf of their users, the EndShipper. Platforms must assert the EndShipper details, as the EndShipper is ultimately responsible for what is in the box. Multiple labels purchased for the same EndShipper must use the same [EndShipper](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/endshippers#endshipper-object) object.

tags.name: Advanced > Events
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/events](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/events) Webhook [Events](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/events#event-object) are triggered by changes in objects you've created via the API. Every time an `Event` related to one of your objects is created, EasyPost guarantees at least one POST request will be sent to each of the [webhook URLs set up for your account](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/webhooks). For this reason, we strongly encourage your webhook handler to be idempotent. See the [webhooks guide](https://docs.easypost.com/guides/webhooks-guide) for more information.

tags.name: Advanced > Orders
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/orders](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/orders) **Note:** Users are encouraged to integrate with the SHIPMENTS endpoint rather than with this ORDERS endpoint, unless they require very specific FedEx, UPS, or DHL Express Multi-parcel rates/labels support. The [Order](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/orders#order-object) object represents a collection of packages and is intended only for multi-parcel shipping; please use [Shipments](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments) for single-parcel shipping. Like a single `Shipment`, each `Order` consists of a [to_address](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/addresses) and [from_address](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/addresses), to be used for each `Shipment` within the `Order`. These `Address` objects will be copied to each `Shipment`, so there is no need to specify them multiple times. Each `Shipment` must then specify its [Parcel](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/parcels), [Options](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/options), and [CustomsInfo](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-infos). ### Additional Notes `orders_create` uses an inline setup `orders_create2` uses the current shipment to and from address with predefined packages Both set the environment variable `ORDER_ID`, which can be accessed by orders_retrieve

tags.name: Advanced > Pickup
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pickups](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pickups) The [Pickup](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pickups#pickup-object) object is used to schedule a pickup from a carrier at a residence or place of business. Once a `Pickup` is successfully created, [PickupRates](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pickups#pickuprate-object) will be automatically fetched for each specified [CarrierAccount](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/carrier-accounts) that supports scheduled pickups. A `PickupRate` must then be selected and purchased to successfully schedule the pickup. ### Additional Notes Use `pickup_create_batch` when trying to create a pickup with batches, and use `pickup_create_shipment` when trying to create a pickup with shipments, with each one referencing the previously created batch or shipment in the previous folders.

tags.name: Advanced > ReadyDocs
tags.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/readydocs](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/readydocs)

ReadyDocs is a document-generation API that enables customers to create standardized packing slips using predefined templates.

ReadyDocs provides a library of approximately 140 packing slip templates, including generic templates that can be used for customer orders. Documents are generated programmatically by submitting order and shipment data to the ReadyDocs API.

**Note:** ReadyDocs is a subscription-based feature, and usage is metered. Requests are authenticated using an EasyPost API key.

tags.name: Advanced > Reports
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/reports](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/reports) A [Report](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/reports#report-object) contains a CSV that is a log of all the objects created within a certain time frame.

tags.name: Advanced > ScanForms
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/scan-form](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/scan-form) A [ScanForm](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/scan-form#scanform-object) can be created to speed up and simplify the carrier pickup process. The `ScanForm` is one document that can be scanned to mark all included tracking codes as "Accepted for Shipment" by the carrier. ### Additional Notes Make sure that all of the batch shipments have been purchased before attempting to create the scanform, as it will throw an error if not true.

tags.name: Advanced > Webhook
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/webhooks](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/webhooks) Each [Webhook](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/webhooks#webhook-object) contains the `url` that EasyPost notifies when an object in the system updates.

tags.name: Account Management > API Keys
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/api-keys](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/api-keys) When performing operations on [API Keys](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/api-keys#api-keys-object) for a specific user, you must be authenticated using a [Production API Key](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/authentication).

tags.name: Account Management > Carrier Accounts
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/carrier-accounts](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/carrier-accounts) A [CarrierAccount](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/carrier-accounts#carrieraccount-object) encapsulates your credentials with the carrier. The `CarrierAccount` object provides CRUD operations for all `CarrierAccounts`.

tags.name: Account Management > Carrier Types
tags.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/carrier-types](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/carrier-types) The [CarrierType](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/carrier-types#carriertype-object) object provides an interface for determining the valid fields of a [CarrierAccount](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/carrier-accounts). The list of `CarrierType` objects only changes when a new carrier is added to EasyPost.

tags.name: Account Management > Users
tags.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/users](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/users)

The User object can be used to manage your own account and to create child accounts. Only a Production mode API key can be used to make requests against the Users API.

tags.name: Account Management > Users > Billing
tags.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/users/billing](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/users/billing)

The `Billing` functions enable account billing management by [adding](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/users/billing#create-credit-card) or [deleting](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/users/billing#delete-a-payment-method) payment methods (credit cards and bank accounts), listing [available payment methods](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/users/billing#retrieve-payment-methods), and [funding wallets](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/users/billing#add-funds-to-your-wallet-one-time-charge).

**Important:** Address verification is triggered when the `verify` or `verify_strict` parameter is included in the request, **even if the value is** **`false`**. To prevent verification, omit these parameters entirely.

Verifying an `Address` before shipping is a great way to reduce issues with delivery.

schema.description: No individual field is strictly required by the API itself (partial addresses are accepted for verification purposes), but street1, city, state, zip and country are needed for a deliverable address.

Insurance for a [Shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments) created within EasyPost must be created via the [Shipment buy](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments#buy-a-shipment) or [Shipment insure](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/shipping-insurance#insure-a-shipment) endpoints. post.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/insurance#refund-an-insurance](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/insurance#refund-an-insurance)

Refunding `Insurance` is only available for standalone insurance purchased through EasyPost. The tracking status for the insurance must be either `pre_transit`, `cancelled`, or `unknown` in order to be eligible.

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/parcels#create-a-parcel](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/parcels#create-a-parcel)

Include the `weight`, and either a `predefined_package` or `length`, `width` and `height` if applicable.

length.description: Inches. Required together with width/height unless predefined_package is set.

width.description: Inches. Required together with length/height unless predefined_package is set.

height.description: Inches. Required together with length/width unless predefined_package is set.

predefined_package.description: Carrier-specific flat-rate package type, used instead of length/width/height.

get.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/parcels#retrieve-a-parcel](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/parcels#retrieve-a-parcel)

Retrieve a `Parcel` by its `id`. In general, you should not need to use this in your automated solution. A `Parcel` object's `id` can be inlined into the creation call to other objects. This allows you to only create one `Parcel` for each package you will be using.

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/rates#retrieve-rates-for-a-shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/rates#retrieve-rates-for-a-shipment) You can retrieve `Rates` without creating a [Shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments) object using this endpoint. This endpoint is ideal when wanting to display or compare rates without creating `Shipment` objects. The `Rate` objects returned by this endpoint do not include IDs.

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/forms#create-form](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/forms#create-form)

Please see the [Forms Guide](https://docs.easypost.com/guides/form-guide) for request parameters.

get.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments#retrieve-all-shipments](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments#retrieve-all-shipments) A list of all `Shipment` objects associated with the given [API Key](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/api-keys) can also be retrieved. See the [Pagination](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pagination) section of our docs for more details on retrieving all records when multiple pages are available.

post.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments#buy-a-shipment-without-rating-one-call-buy](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments#buy-a-shipment-without-rating-one-call-buy)

The one-call buy method enables shipment creation and label purchase in a single API call. This approach is suitable when the desired service level is already known, or a flat-rate agreement is in place with the carrier.

length.description: Inches. Required together with width/height unless predefined_package is set.

width.description: Inches. Required together with length/height unless predefined_package is set.

height.description: Inches. Required together with length/width unless predefined_package is set.

predefined_package.description: Carrier-specific flat-rate package type, used instead of length/width/height.

schema.description: One-call buy requires to_address, from_address and parcel; include "service" and/or "carrier_accounts" to pin the rate purchased, otherwise the lowest available rate is bought.

post.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/rates#regenerate-rates-for-a-shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/rates#regenerate-rates-for-a-shipment)

You can regenerate the `Rates` of a `Shipment` at any time. This is ideal when shipments aren't bought the same day as they were created and you want the most up-to-date rates available. This operation respects the `carrier_accounts` attribute.
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/shipping-insurance#insure-a-shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/shipping-insurance#insure-a-shipment)

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/shipping-refund#refund-a-shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/shipping-refund#refund-a-shipment) Refunding a [Shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments) is available for many carriers supported by EasyPost.

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments#buy-a-shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments#buy-a-shipment) To purchase a `Shipment`, specify the [Rate](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments/rates) to buy. This operation returns the `tracking_code` and `postage_label` attributes.

id.description: Rate ID from the shipment's rates array.

get.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments#retrieve-a-shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments#retrieve-a-shipment)

A `Shipment` can be retrieved by either its `id` or `reference`. However, it is recommended to use EasyPost's provided identifiers because uniqueness on `reference` is not enforced.

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments#converting-the-label-format-of-a-shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments#converting-the-label-format-of-a-shipment) A `Shipment`'s [PostageLabel](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments#postage-label-object) can be converted from PNG to other formats. To convert a `PostageLabel`, the original must be a PNG. Converting labels works best when they are 4x6 labels converted from PNG to ZPL.

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches#retrieve-all-batches](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches#retrieve-all-batches) A list of all `Batch` objects associated with the given [API Key](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/api-keys) can also be retrieved. See the [Pagination](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pagination) section of our docs for more details on retrieving all records when multiple pages are available.

post.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches#create-a-batch](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches#create-a-batch) A `Batch` can be created with or without [Shipments](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments). When created with `Shipments`, the initial `state` will be "creating". Once the `state` changes to "created", a webhook [Event](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/events) will be sent. When created with no [Shipments](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments), the initial state will be "created" and webhook will be sent. **Note:** It is recommended to keep each batch under 1,000 shipments. This best practice helps avoid timeout errors during the batch buying process.

schema.description: No fields are required — a Batch can be created empty and shipments added afterward.

post.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches#add-shipments-to-a-batch](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches#add-shipments-to-a-batch)

[Shipments](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments) can be added to a `Batch` throughout its life cycle. Just remember that the state change of a `Batch` is asynchronous and will fire a webhook [Event](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/events) when the state change is completed.

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches#remove-shipments-from-a-batch](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches#remove-shipments-from-a-batch) There could be times when a [Shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments) needs to be removed from the `Batch` during its life cycle. Removing a `Shipment` does not remove it from the consolidated label or [ScanForm](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/scan-form).

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches#buy-a-batch](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches#buy-a-batch) Once you have added all of your [Shipments](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments) to a `Batch`, issue a buy request to enqueue a background job to purchase the shipments and generate all necessary labels.

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches#batch-labels](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches#batch-labels) One of the advantages of processing [Shipments](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments) in batches is the ability to consolidate the `PostageLabel` into one file. This can only be done once for each batch, and all `Shipments` must have a status of "postage_purchased".

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches#manifesting-scan-form](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches#manifesting-scan-form) A [ScanForm](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/scan-form) can be created for a `Batch` by its `id`.

get.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches#retrieve-batch](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches#retrieve-batch)

A `Batch` can be retrieved by either its `id` or `reference`. However it is recommended to use EasyPost's provided identifiers because uniqueness on `reference` is not enforced.

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/carrier-metadata](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/carrier-metadata)

Retrieve all `CarrierMetadata` for all carriers on the EasyPost platform. Optionally, filter the response by specifying a list of carriers or metadata types.

post.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-infos#create-a-customsinfo](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-infos#create-a-customsinfo) A `CustomsInfo` object contains all administrative information for processing customs, as well as a list of [CustomsItems](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-items). When creating a `CustomsInfo`, you may store the `id` from the response for use later in [Shipment creation](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments#create-a-shipment).

get.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-infos#retrieve-a-customsinfo](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-infos#retrieve-a-customsinfo)

A `CustomsInfo` can be retrieved by its `id`.

post.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-items#create-a-customsitem](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-items#create-a-customsitem) A `CustomsItem` contains information relating to each product within the package. When creating a `CustomsItem`, you may store the `id` from the response for use later in [CustomsInfo creation](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-infos#create-a-customsinfo).

get.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-items#retrieve-a-customsitem](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/customs-items#retrieve-a-customsitem)

A `CustomsItem` can be retrieved by its `id`.

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/endshippers#retrieve-all-endshippers](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/endshippers#retrieve-all-endshippers)

List the `EndShippers` that have been created.

post.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/endshippers#create-an-endshipper](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/endshippers#create-an-endshipper)

The `EndShipper` object is meant to represent the person or business entity responsible for the shipment and not necessarily the shipping location.

schema.description: Same shape as Address creation; street1, city, state, zip, country, name and phone are needed for a usable EndShipper.

get.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/endshippers#retrieve-an-endshipper](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/endshippers#retrieve-an-endshipper)

Similar to retrieving a list of `EndShippers`, you can retrieve an individual `EndShipper`.

put.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/endshippers#update-an-endshipper](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/endshippers#update-an-endshipper)

An `EndShipper` object may be updated using the EndShipper API. All required fields for creating an `EndShipper` are required in an update request. Partial updates are not supported.

get.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/events#retrieve-all-events](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/events#retrieve-all-events) A list of all `Event` objects associated with the given [API Key](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/api-keys) can also be retrieved. See the [Pagination](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pagination) section of our docs for more details on retrieving all records when multiple pages are available.

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/events#retrieve-an-event](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/events#retrieve-an-event)

An `Event` can be retrieved by its `id`.

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/events/payloads#retrieve-all-payloads](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/events/payloads#retrieve-all-payloads) Retrieve all `Payloads` by [Event](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/events) ID.

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/events/payloads#retrieve-a-payload](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/events/payloads#retrieve-a-payload) A `Payload` must be retrieved with both an [Event](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/events) ID and `Payload` ID.

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/orders#retrieve-an-order](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/orders#retrieve-an-order)

An `Order` can be retrieved by either its `id` or `reference`. However, it is recommended to use EasyPost's provided identifiers because uniqueness on `reference` is not enforced.

post.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/orders#buy-an-order-without-rating-one-call-buy](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/orders#buy-an-order-without-rating-one-call-buy)

There is an alternative way to purchase orders that is known as the "one-call buy" method. This method is often used if you have a flat-rate set with a mail carrier for a given service level, or if you know your desired service level without needing to see the rate first.

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/orders#buy-an-order](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/orders#buy-an-order) To purchase an `Order`, you only need to specify the `carrier` and `service`. This operation populates the `tracking_code` and `postage_label` attributes of each [Shipment](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments) in the order.

get.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pickups#retrieve-all-pickups](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pickups#retrieve-all-pickups) A list of all `Pickup` objects associated with the given [API Key](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/api-keys) can be retrieved.

post.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pickups#create-a-pickup](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pickups#create-a-pickup)

Creating a `Pickup` will automatically fetch rates for the given time frame and location.

shipment.description: Shipment (or use "batch") the pickup is for.

post.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pickups#buy-a-pickup](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pickups#buy-a-pickup) To purchase a `Pickup`, a [PickupRate](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pickups#pickuprate-object) must be specified by its `carrier` and `service` name, instead of its `id`.

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pickups#cancel-a-pickup](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pickups#cancel-a-pickup)

You may cancel a `Pickup` any time before it has been completed.

get.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pickups#retrieve-a-pickup](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/pickups#retrieve-a-pickup)

A `Pickup` object can be retrieved by either an `id` or `reference`.

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/scan-form#retrieve-all-scanforms](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/scan-form#retrieve-all-scanforms) A list of all `ScanForm` objects associated with the given [API Key](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/api-keys) can also be retrieved.

post.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/scan-form#create-a-scanform](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/scan-form#create-a-scanform) A `ScanForm` can be created in two ways: - Create a `ScanForm` for [Shipments](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/shipments) directly - [Create a ScanForm for a Batch](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/batches#manifesting-scan-form) of `Shipments`

get.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/scan-form#retrieve-a-scanform](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/scan-form#retrieve-a-scanform)

Retrieve a `ScanForm` by its `id`.

[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/webhooks#retrieve-all-webhooks](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/webhooks#retrieve-all-webhooks) Retrieve an unpaginated list of all `Webhooks` associated with the [API Key](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/api-keys).

post.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/webhooks#create-a-webhook](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/webhooks#create-a-webhook)

To create a `Webhook`, provide a `url` parameter to designate where notifications are sent.

get.description:
[https://docs.easypost.com/docs/webhooks#retrieve-a-webhook](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/webhooks#retrieve-a-webhook)

Retrieve a `Webhook` by `id`.

patch.description: [https://docs.easypost.com/docs/webhooks#update-a-webhook](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/webhooks#update-a-webhook) Re-enable a disabled `Webhook` or update the [webhook_secret](https://docs.easypost.com/docs/webhooks#hmac-validation) and `custom_headers`.
